name: mDNS-based automatic data sync to Linux PC

mentions.name: mDNS-based automatic data sync to Linux PC
mentions.description: A tool in development that uses mDNS to automatically sync Apple Watch data to a Linux PC when the user is at home; the author hopes it could eventually also sync desktop music as an alternative to the Apple Music app.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a way with MDNS to sync data to my Linux PC automatically when I'm at home.

evidence.value: I'm working on a way with MDNS to sync data to my Linux PC automatically when I'm at home.
